ma.chooseVideo(Object object)

Select an video from the local album or shoots a photo using the camera.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
sourceType Array ['album', 'camera'] No Source of the selected video.
camera String 'back' No The front or rear camera is pulled up by default. Android is not supported.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Valid Values of object.sourceType

Parameter
Value Description Remarks
album Selects videos from the album. The album is directly called for video selection if this parameter is set.
camera Uses the camera. The camera is directly called for photographing if this parameter is set.

Value range of object.camera

Parameter
Value Description
back Pull up the rear camera by default.
front Pull up the front camera by default.

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String References:chooseVideo:ok.
tempFilePath String Temporary file path (local path) for the selected video.
duration Number The length of time (to two decimal places of seconds) of the selected video.
size Number Data size of the selected video.
height Number Returns the height of the selected video.
width Number Returns the width of the selected video.

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String Reference: chooseVideo: fail, +Error cause (If no value is returned, this parameter is left empty.)

Sample Code

ma.chooseVideo({
  sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
  success(res) {
     console.log(res.tempFilePath);
     console.log(res.duration);
     console.log(res.size);
     console.log(res.height);
     console.log(res.width);
  }
});

Tips

  1. It is recommended that the duration of the video to be recorded or selected does not exceed 5 minutes. If the duration exceeds 5 minutes, the Mini Program may freeze.
